name: Handshake
tagline: Simple written agreements for everyday deals
about: Handshake drafts short, plain-English agreements for everyday deals — lending money to a friend, splitting a flat, selling a used car, a small freelance job, borrowing equipment — so everyone remembers the same thing later.
persona: You are a friendly drafter of simple agreements: short sentences, every 'what if' covered, no legalese unless it earns its place, and honest about when a lawyer should look.

onboarding.title: Put it in writing, kindly
onboarding.subtitle: Where you are affects what makes an agreement enforceable.

tools.title: Personal loan agreement
tools.subtitle: Lend to friends and stay friends
tools.prompt: Draft a personal loan agreement: {parties}, amount {amount}, repayment: {terms}. Output a quote with the full agreement (parties, amount, repayment dates, interest stated or zero, late-payment rule, early repayment, what happens if a payment is missed, governing region, signature lines), a table (Date | Payment | Balance after), and a callout on gift-versus-loan clarity and when interest may have tax implications.

tools.title: Housemate agreement
tools.subtitle: Rent, bills, chores, leaving

inputs.label: Who lives there
inputs.placeholder: 3 of us, Sam on the lease

inputs.label: What you've agreed so far
inputs.placeholder: rent split by room size, bills equal, 1 month notice to leave…

tools.prompt: Housemates: {people}. Agreed so far: {rules}. Produce a quote with a housemate agreement (contributions and due dates, bills, deposit shares, guests, cleaning, quiet hours, notice to leave and replacement-housemate process, dispute steps), a checklist of things they haven't decided yet, and a callout on how this relates to the actual tenancy with the landlord.

tools.title: Private sale receipt
tools.subtitle: Sold as seen, done right

inputs.label: Known faults / condition
inputs.placeholder: small dent rear bumper, inspection valid till Nov

tools.prompt: Draft a bill of sale and receipt for {item} at {price}, disclosed condition: {known}. Quote the document (buyer, seller, item identifiers, price, payment method, a 'sold as described' statement with the disclosed faults, date of handover, signatures), a checklist of handover steps for this kind of item in the profile region (ownership transfer, keys, documents), and a callout on what 'sold as seen' does and doesn't protect against.

tools.title: Small job agreement
tools.subtitle: Scope, price, deadline, changes

inputs.label: The job
inputs.placeholder: build a 5-page website for a florist

tools.prompt: Write a one-page agreement for {job} at {price}, timeline and payment: {timeline}. Quote the agreement (scope with what's excluded, deliverables, revisions allowed, payment schedule, deadline, change requests, cancellation, who owns the work, signatures), a table (Milestone | Due | Payment), and bullets on the three clauses that prevent most freelance disputes.

tools.title: Make it count
tools.subtitle: Signing, witnessing, storing
tools.prompt: For a {kind} agreement worth {value} in the profile region: kv (does it need a witness, wet signature or e-signature, how many copies, how long to keep), steps to sign and store properly, and a callout on when the value or subject means a professional should draft it instead.

disclaimer: General information only, not legal advice; rules differ by country and state and change over time — check official sources or a qualified professional before acting.
